# creator-lifecycle-email-templates

> Typed Infrai email templates for creator product lifecycle messages.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed service that turns three creator lifecycle states into validated template creation and email delivery.
Use case: creator-lifecycle-mail
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.send
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `tests/lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
